properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that all assertions are satisfied in the program.
Verify that the output 'o' is calculated correctly for 'i' = 0.

property.pattern_description: 'instance.i = 0 --> instance.o = 0' is always true at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that the output 'o' is calculated correctly for 'i' in the range 1 to 5.

pattern_params.1: instance.i >= 1 AND instance.i <= 5 --> instance.o = instance.i * instance.i

property.pattern_description: 'instance.i >= 1 AND instance.i <= 5 --> instance.o = instance.i * instance.i' is always true at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that the output 'o' is calculated correctly for 'i' in the range 6 to 10.

property.pattern_description: 'instance.i >= 6 AND instance.i <= 10 --> instance.o = instance.i + (instance.i * 2)' is always true at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that the output 'o' is -1 for any other value of 'i'.

property.pattern_description: 'instance.i < 0 OR instance.i > 10 --> instance.o = -1' is always true at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that the program does not produce invalid outputs.

property.pattern_description: 'instance.o <= 32767 AND instance.o >= -32767'  is always true at the end of the PLC cycle.
